lines.text: 3.6Majortypesof settlements inPakistan
Pakistan is one of the most populous country in South Asia.According to data compiled by World
Bank in2019,almost37% of population resides in urban areas whereas63% is living inrural areas.
We can see different patterns and types of settlements in Pakistan on the basis of population
size, densityandarea.There are twomain types of settlements in Pakistan
1.Ruralsettlements
2.Urban settlements
1.RuralSettlements
About two third of the total population of Pakistan live in rural areas called villages. Rural
settlements in Pakistan can be categorized into major three types on the basis of pattern -
clustered, Nucleated and Dispersed. Clustered and nucleated settlements are found in
fertile plains of Punjab and Sindh. Linear pattern can also be seen mostly along rivers and
roads in mountain valley. In Pakistan Swat valley provides an impressive scene of linear
settlement pattern along the River Swat.Dispersed settlement can be seen in mountainous
and desert areas of Pakistan like Chitral, Dir and Azad Kashmir Thar and some parts of
Baluchistan. The main occupations of rural settlement are agriculture, cattle raring, fishery
andothertraditionalactivities.
